name: Sabra Classic Hummus (Raw Garlic & Skin WARNING)
whyItWorks: Contains un-hulled chickpea skins, heavy raw minced garlic, citric acid, and tahini. The raw garlic fructans and fibrous chickpea hulls ferment vigorously in the colon, producing painful bloating and sulfurous gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid commercial hummus containing raw garlic. Make your own skinned, garlic-free hummus at home.
